children: State Bank of India Sponsored GDR RegS (NSE:SBIN) trimmed its IPO offer-for-sale as SBI cut its share sale and joined a ₹430 crore ONDC funding round, even as chair C.S. Setty flagged short-lived liquidity surges and the bank warned possible service disruptions from a UFBU strike on Sept 11.
: SBIN: SBI and SBI Capital cut their NSE IPO offer-for-sale from ~148.9M to ~126.4M shares; SBI trimmed its sale to ~16M shares. SBI acquisition cost ~Rs0.80; IPO band Rs1,700–1,785.
: SBIN GDR: SBI chair C.S. Setty said excess liquidity unlikely to distort credit growth and should be absorbed in 3–4 months. System liquidity rose above ₹10 trillion via FCNR(B) and forex inflows.
: SBIN GDR: UFBU strike notice set for Sept 11. SBI says branches arranged to operate but warns banking services may be disrupted, potentially affecting SBIN trading liquidity and settlement.
: SBIN joined a ₹430 crore funding round for ONDC to back logistics, mobility and rural supply‑chain digitization under ONDC 2.0 — relevant for traders tracking SBI's strategic investments.
: SBIN listed for Tatkal NPS on BHIM app: eligible SBI users can open NPS via app with instant e-KYC and immediate PRAN; minimum initial contribution Rs 250.
